name: Heart Rupturer raises all four named spells by 20% (#2210)
contract: Heart Rupturer 680685 effect 0 is aura 108 with MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20%, over DBC EffectSpellClassMask (0, 8193, 2147500032): word 1 bit 0 Ravenous Strike (500123, 501671-501679), word 1 bit 13 Bloodmoon Blast (500125, 501607-501614, 572332), word 2 bit 14 Claw Sweep (500169, 500436-500441, 500444) and word 2 bit 31 the Sanguine Rupture cast rows (572907, 800774, 802456-802461). Per Bloodmage ADR 0042 (979d11c21d), AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp OnLoadSpellCustomAttr adds Sanguine Rupture's damage payload 800775 class mask (word 1 0x00200000) to 680685 effect 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, op: 0) and clears 680685 effect 1 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, op: 8) on the Sanguine Rupture cast wrapper so 800775 receives +20% once (covering both base damage and its +0.35 SP bonus) without double-dipping (+44%). Tooltip: "Increases the damage of Claw Sweep, Sanguine Rupture, Ravenous Strike and Bloodmoon Blast by $s1%." The spell_modifier metric returns Player::ApplySpellMod's float, and the percent branch computes totalmul *= CalculatePct(1.0f, 120.0f) = 1.2f, so 100 * 1.2f lands one ULP above 120 (measured 120.00000762939453). The +20% steps therefore assert 119.9-120.1, a band that still excludes the unmodified 100.
